contract.reader: Someone with basic electrical engineering (voltage, current, switches, relays) and no digital-logic or PLC background, deciding whether and where to start the series
contract.problem: Knowing what the series covers, in what order, what it assumes and what they will be able to do at the end
contract.outcome: Choose a starting point; know the prerequisites, the five objectives and the shared conventions
contract.contribution: The dependency chain of the five entries (logic, PLC, networks, feedback loops, upper layers and digital twins) stated in one paragraph, with one checkable objective per entry
contract.evidence: None needed beyond the entries; each claim about an entry checked against its source
contract.limitations: An orientation page; it teaches nothing itself
